title: URGENT: Finder에서 Audiso Music 폴더 mkdir (자동동기화)
instruction: CEO: Gmail Drive is visible in Finder but Audiso Music missing. Run mac-bootstrap-from-git.sh — mkdir Audiso Music inside My Drive / 내 드라이브. No Drive API. Finder folder auto-syncs to phone. Account okas2000@gmail.com only.
